$comment: Project-owned FloScan schema generated from src/floscan/contracts; not the assignment's published schema, which is unavailable. Semantic invariants live in the model validators.

AssetRef.description: A file inside a capture or run root, identified by content hash.
AssetRef.title: AssetRef

ConcealedDamageFlag.description: A rule recommends inspection; it does not prove a hidden defect.
ConcealedDamageFlag.title: ConcealedDamageFlag

ConfidenceInterval.description: Predictive error interval for the unknown true value of a measurement.
ConfidenceInterval.title: ConfidenceInterval

Connector.description: Traversable link between two rooms, backed by an opening on each side.
Connector.title: Connector

Constraint.description: One factor between two graph nodes, accepted or rejected with a reason.
Constraint.title: Constraint

CoordinateFrame.description: A named frame. Different sessions never share a frame implicitly.
CoordinateFrame.title: CoordinateFrame

DamageRegion.description: One physical damage region, fused across views; image areas are not summed.
DamageRegion.title: DamageRegion

Measurement.description: One scalar quantity of one subject, with one definition and one unit.
Measurement.title: Measurement

Opening.description: Opening on a host wall, dimensioned by one aperture definition only.
Opening.title: Opening

Polygon2D.description: Closed simple polygon: CCW outer ring, CW holes, metres in its frame.
Polygon2D.title: Polygon2D

PredicateEvaluation.description: One inspectable predicate of a rule, with what was observed.
PredicateEvaluation.title: PredicateEvaluation

PropertyGraph.description: Rooms, submaps and constraints; components never share an origin silently.
PropertyGraph.title: PropertyGraph

Provenance.description: Where a record came from. Inference provenance never holds ground truth.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Room.description: A room in its local frame, placed in the property frame only with evidence.
Room.title: Room

RunManifest.description: Everything needed to identify and replay a run. Never holds ground truth.
RunManifest.title: RunManifest

ScopeItem.description: A line of work keyed to one surface version; never a cost.
ScopeItem.title: ScopeItem

SectionCoverage.description:
What one output section contains, checked against the result's records.

``evidence_ids`` name the records that back the claim. For damage regions
they make a negative finding explicit: ``available`` with no regions is
valid only when the inspected surfaces are listed.
SectionCoverage.title: SectionCoverage

Surface.description: A planar surface patch with a metric (u, v) chart; versions track edits.
Surface.title: Surface

Wall.description: Interior finished face of one wall, as seen from its room.
Wall.title: Wall

description:
Internal result of one run (project-owned schema ``internal-v0``).

Status ``ok`` means every internal section is available and verified
against the records. The public-schema export can never be ``available``
here: the evaluator schema is unavailable, so ``ok`` results carry it as
``blocked_external`` (or ``unavailable``) with a reason.
title: PropertyResult
